card.name: Digits inside years in citizenship history
card.fires_on: Digits inside a year or date (like the 0 in 1906 or 1801) in history passages about citizenship, naturalization and migration. It also fires on words like consul and wherein near residency or citizenship wording.

modes.label: Digits in years
modes.description: A digit partway through a four-digit year or date in a text about naturalization or migration.

modes.label: Citizenship and residence words
modes.description: Words like consul or wherein in text about citizens, states and where people reside.
modes.example: citizens of the United States and of the State<< wherein>> they reside.

card.writes: It suppresses resident and reside words in many languages, so it steers the model away from residence terms.
card.plain: It lights up on digits within years in passages about citizenship and immigration history, and it holds back words like resident.
